paite: TOUPA'N Zion salte apikik nan lai in, mang nei bang hial i hi ua.
heading: Hotkhiakna Dia Thumna
english: A Song of Ascents. When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

paite: Huai lai in i kam uh nuihna in adim a, i lei uh lasakna in; huai lai in namte lak ah, TOUPA'N amau a ding in thil thupi ahihsak ahi, achi ua.
english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”

paite: TOUPA'N thil thupitak hon hihsak a; i kipak mahmah ahi.
english: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka saltanna ua kipan hon pikik nawn in, simlam luite bang in.
english: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.

paite: Khitui ke kawm a tuhte'n nuamsatak in a-at ding uhi.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

paite: Kap kawm a buhchi kuankhiakpihmi in, abuhphalte uh tawi in nuamsa in ahong pai nawn ding hi.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
